# Qwen4 preview

Qwen4 has not been released. This post describes the plans for the next generation of the Qwen family and what the team can say today.

The team has shown early results from a preview model internally and says it will share more when the training run finishes. No parameter count has been confirmed, and the team asks the community not to rely on numbers that circulate on social media.

## Current models

The newest released model in the family remains Qwen3.5. It supports a context window of 128k tokens and is available as open weights in several sizes.

A date for Qwen4 has not been given. The team wrote that it will announce the release on this blog first, and that the announcement will come with weights and a technical report.
